item.title: Bulletin updated at 04:50 HKT 04/Dec/2022
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A replenishment of the northeast monsoon will reach the coast of Guangdong today. It will be cool in the morning over the region in the next couple of days. A relatively dry continental airstream is expected to bring generally fine weather to southern China in the middle and latter parts of this week.

Date/Month: 04/12 (Sunday)

Weather: Mainly cloudy with sunny periods.
Temp range: 18 - 23 C
R.H. range: 60 - 85 per Cent
